1 Bedroom in 3BR Student Apt — 192 Regina St N, Waterloo, ON (Winter 2027)

Available Jan 1 to Apr 30, 2027. Rent is $960/month including water, heat, and Wi-Fi (hydro split 3 ways, ~$25/mo). Furnished bedroom, 12-minute walk to UW or 5 minutes on the GRT 7/ION. Property is managed off-site by a local landlord (does not live in the building). Happy to arrange an in-person walkthrough whenever works for you. Note on rent payments: the property manager insists on either handing over four cheques pre-dated for the 1st of Jan–Apr at key pickup, or enrolling in mandatory automatic bank withdrawals through their payment portal (no monthly e-transfers). Email regina192@example.com.
label_rationale: Legitimate-sounding sublet with ONE subtle paraphrased illegal requirement: insisting on either pre-dated cheques or mandatory automatic bank withdrawals violates Ontario RTA s. 108(a)-(b) (neither a landlord nor a tenancy agreement shall require post-dated cheques or automatic debit/payment) and is void under s. 4(1). Not a scam; under SPEC D6, HOLD.
